findings: The candidate subscribes to every EventBus event and fires on the first event without checking EventEndOfCombat. Formatting alone cannot justify acceptance.
The test only asserts a custom counter map entry; verify that a -0/-2 counter reduces actual toughness.
Test attacking and blocking relationships separately, preserving unrelated creatures and end-of-combat timing.
Original candidate gates stopped at gofmt; the runtime behavior was not established.

Use GameState.CombatState.Blockers as combat authority, not the mirrored Card.Blocking / BlockingCardID fields. Read both source-as-attacker and source-as-blocker relationships from the canonical map.
Current Counters.GetToughnessModifier only counts +1/+1 and -1/-1; the -0/-2 semantic gap requires a bounded counters.go prerequisite.

The converter already supports TriggerV2 event end_combat / legacy end_of_combat. Prefer that actual trigger plus an explicit related-creatures counter effect over promoting every blocks counter trigger into a deferred effect.
